answer: Locks are recorded in garden, expire in voyage, and atlas lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Someone running 137 aliases therefore needs 86 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3531 identities would post 3106 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
